title: BM25 Ranking
body: BM25 scores a page against a query from the frequency of each query term in the page, the rarity of the term across all pages and the page length. The parameter k1 sets term frequency saturation: after a few occurrences, more repeats of a term add little to the score. The parameter b sets how strongly long pages are penalised.

title: Vector Embeddings
body: An embedding model maps a piece of text to a dense vector of a few hundred numbers. Texts with related meaning map to nearby vectors, so dense vector similarity, usually the cosine of the angle between two vectors, finds passages that share no words with the query.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
body: Reciprocal rank fusion is a method to merge ranked lists from several retrievers into one. Each document receives the sum of 1/(k + rank) over the lists it appears in, with k usually set to 60. It uses only ranks, so scores on different scales need no calibration.

title: Wikilinks
body: A wikilink is a reference from one wiki page to another, written as double bracket links such as [[concepts/rag]]. The target is a page id, and an optional label after a vertical bar sets the text shown to the reader. A link that names no existing page is reported as broken.

title: Frontmatter
body: Frontmatter is the page metadata header at the top of a markdown file, written in YAML between two lines of three dashes. It holds the title, the list of sources, the created and updated dates, the page type and the confidence level. Tools read it without parsing the page body.

title: PageRank
body: PageRank gives each page a share of importance computed from the link graph: a page linked from many important pages becomes important itself. The computation repeats until the scores stop changing, with a damping factor of about 0.85 that models a reader who sometimes jumps to a random page.

title: Stopwords
body: Stopwords are common words removed from text before indexing, such as the, is and of. They appear in nearly every document, so they carry little information for ranking, and dropping them makes the index smaller.

title: Contradiction Detection
body: Contradiction detection compares new claims with the claims already stored in the wiki and flags pairs that cannot both be true, for example conflicting source claims about the release year of one product. A flagged pair is kept for a human to resolve instead of being overwritten.

title: 中文分词
body: 中文分词是把连续的汉字序列切分成词语的过程。中文书写时词与词之间没有空格，所以检索系统必须先确定词语边界，才能建立以词为单位的索引。常见方法包括基于词典的最大匹配和基于统计模型的序列标注。

title: 知识图谱
body: 知识图谱用节点表示实体，用边表示实体之间的关系，例如某人出生于某城市。它把零散的事实组织成网络，使系统可以沿着关系进行多步推理，并回答需要连接多个事实的问题。

title: 倒排索引
body: 倒排索引为每个词记录包含它的文档列表。查询时，系统只需读取查询词对应的文档列表并求交集，而不必逐篇扫描全部文档，因此检索速度很快。

title: 文本摘要
body: 文本摘要把一篇长文压缩成保留要点的短文。抽取式摘要直接挑选原文中的重要句子，生成式摘要则用新的句子改写原文的主要内容。

title: 命名实体识别
body: 命名实体识别从文本中找出人名、地名、机构名等专有名称，并标注它们的类别。它常作为信息抽取的第一步，为后续的关系抽取提供候选实体。

title: 问答系统
body: 问答系统接收用自然语言提出的问题，并直接返回答案，而不是返回一组相关文档。检索式问答先找到相关段落，再从段落中定位答案所在的片段。

title: 文本分类
body: 文本分类为每篇文档分配一个或多个预先定义的类别，例如把邮件分为正常邮件和垃圾邮件。模型从带标签的训练样本中学习每个类别的特征。

title: 机器翻译
body: 机器翻译把一种语言的文本自动转换成另一种语言。神经机器翻译用编码器读取源语言句子，再用解码器逐词生成目标语言句子。

title: Data Augmentation
body: Data augmentation enlarges a training set by adding modified copies of existing examples, such as rotated images or sentences with replaced synonyms. It reduces overfitting when labelled data is scarce.

title: Hash Tables
body: A hash table stores key and value pairs in an array of buckets. A hash function maps each key to a bucket index, so a lookup takes constant time on average. Two keys that map to one bucket are a collision, resolved by chaining or open addressing.

title: Sorting Algorithms
body: A sorting algorithm puts the items of a list in order. Merge sort splits the list in half, sorts each half and merges the two sorted lists; quicksort partitions the list around a pivot. Both take about n log n comparisons on average.

title: Version Control
body: A version control system records each change to a set of files with its author, date and message. Branches let several people work in parallel, and a merge combines their changes; a conflict arises when two branches edit the same lines.

title: 图像识别
body: 图像识别让计算机判断一张图片中包含什么物体。卷积神经网络逐层提取边缘、纹理和形状等特征，最后输出每个类别的概率。

title: 数据库事务
body: 数据库事务是一组要么全部成功、要么全部撤销的操作。事务保证原子性、一致性、隔离性和持久性，使并发写入不会让数据处于中间状态。

title: 进程调度
body: 操作系统的进程调度决定哪个进程在什么时候使用处理器。常见策略有先来先服务、时间片轮转和优先级调度。

title: 数据压缩
body: 数据压缩用更少的位表示同样的信息。无损压缩可以完整还原原始数据，有损压缩则舍弃人眼或人耳不易察觉的细节，以换取更高的压缩率。
